notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_en: A Day view for your schedule
notes.title_zh: 日程里多了「日」视图

en: The Schedule tab now has a Day view: one day with every event detail, your to-dos, and what's on now or next. It remembers your choice.
zh: 日程标签页现在多了「日」视图：只看一天，日程的每条详情、你的待办，还有正在进行和接下来的安排都在这里。它会记住你的选择。

en: The briefing header now shows your secretary at a fixed size in a soft lamp glow, with a smaller greeting and the opening line in a speech bubble.
Morning Sky's birds now stay still, and only the flock beside the sun remains.
First Light now fades into warm paper below its opening scene instead of repeating the valley, and the secretary page is no longer green.
Morning and evening briefings are prepared faster and more reliably handle requests like moving a task to another day.
zh: 简报顶栏里的秘书现在大小固定，罩着一层柔和的灯光；问候语变小了，开场的话放进了对话气泡里。
Morning Sky 的飞鸟现在停住不动了，只留下太阳旁边的那一群。
First Light 在开场画面往下，现在过渡成温暖的纸色，不再重复那片山谷；秘书页面也不再是绿色的了。
早间和晚间简报准备得更快，处理「把待办挪到另一天」这类请求也更稳。

en: Pages using Morning Sky scroll smoothly again instead of lagging.
The avatar picker is fully visible and clickable on the secretary page and on briefings at tablet and desktop sizes.
The secretary's portrait lines up with the top of the conversation again.
Project labels in the Schedule no longer appear as empty boxes.
zh: 用 Morning Sky 的页面滚动又变流畅了，不再卡顿。
在平板和电脑尺寸下，秘书页面和简报里的形象选择都能完整看到，也点得到了。
秘书的形象又和对话的顶部对齐了。
日程里的项目标签不会再显示成空框了。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 日程章节开头多了摘要

en: Schedule sections in your morning and evening briefings now open with a short summary of the day.
zh: 早间和晚间简报里的日程章节，现在开头会有一小段当天的摘要。

en: Older patch notes are rewritten to focus on what changed for you.
zh: 往期的更新日志都重写了一遍，重点说清楚对你来说有哪些变化。

en: The maintenance page shows its normal styling again while the website updates.
zh: 网站更新时，维护页面恢复正常样式了。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 秘书请求不再卡住

en: Secretary requests no longer get stuck waiting without progress.
zh: 秘书请求不会再卡在等待里、迟迟没有进展。

en: We are sorry secretary requests could get stuck waiting without progress.
zh: 很抱歉，之前秘书请求可能会卡在等待里、没有进展。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 中文请求使用免费模型 🎉

en: Chinese requests now use DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free; English stays the same.
zh: 中文请求现在使用 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free，英文请求保持不变。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_en: Evening splits today and future tasks
notes.title_zh: 晚间把今天和以后的任务分开

en: Evening checks now show due-today tasks first with an optional Future tasks section.
Future tasks keep their original dates so nothing looks due early.
zh: 晚间检查现在先显示今天到期的待办，另外还有一个可选的「未来任务」章节。
未来的待办会保留原来的日期，不会有任务看起来提前到期。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 幕后优化

en: Behind-the-scenes improvements; the website works the same.
zh: 幕后优化，网站的使用方式不变。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 晚间的待办说明更清楚

en: Evening Tasks now show clearer titles and details, like mornings.
zh: 晚间待办现在的标题和细节更清楚，和早间一样。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 秘书请求队列不再卡住

en: Briefings no longer get stuck when preparation fails.
Accepted requests no longer disappear after waiting.
Sending the same message twice no longer creates a duplicate request.
zh: 准备失败时，简报不会再卡住。
已经接下的请求，等待之后不会再消失。
同一条消息连发两次，不会再生成重复的请求。

en: We are sorry secretary requests could wait without progress. Thank you for reporting it.
zh: 很抱歉，之前秘书请求可能会一直等待、没有进展。谢谢你把它反馈给我们。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 简报里的当天定时日程

en: Morning briefings now show today's timed appointments, and Evening shows tomorrow's.
All-day events still show a three-day glance, and empty days show a single-day note.
zh: 早间简报现在显示今天的定时约定，晚间显示明天的。
全天日程仍然显示三天的概览，空着的那天只给一句当天的提示。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_en: Secretary calls and clearer completed tasks
notes.title_zh: 秘书回访，已完成的待办更清楚

en: New Secretary calls list past records that need a question; nothing is asked until you approve, and answers happen in chat.
Time windows without a clear repeat, like early November, now ask how often and when to start before saving.
zh: 新增秘书回访：会把需要提问的旧记录列出来；在你同意之前不会问任何问题，回答也在对话里进行。
像「11 月初」这种没有明确重复规律的时间段，保存前会先问清多久一次、从什么时候开始。

en: Completed Schedule tasks now show a clearer strikethrough and label in day and night themes.
zh: 已完成的日程待办，在白天和夜间主题下的删除线和标签都更清楚了。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 更友好的维护页面

en: The website now shows a friendly bilingual maintenance page during updates, and sign-out still works.
zh: 更新期间，网站会显示一个友好的双语维护页面，退出登录照常可用。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 为灵活习惯定制的日程

en: Secretary can now save custom routines for flexible habits that fixed repeats cannot express.
Morning briefings show due custom routines, Evening checks list them as tick boxes, and chat highlights them as cards.
zh: 对于那些固定重复表达不了的灵活习惯，秘书现在可以保存自定义的日程。
早间简报会显示当天到期的自定义日程，晚间检查把它们列成可勾选的小方框，对话里则以卡片突出显示。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_en: Secretary setup, voice and language routing
notes.title_zh: 秘书初始化、语气和语言分工

en: New profiles now start with Initialize, then unlock Secretary, To-do and Eureka.
Website language now picks the model automatically, and the manual model picker is gone.
zh: 新账号会从初始化开始，之后才解锁秘书、待办和灵感。
网站语言现在会自动决定用哪个模型，手动选择模型的地方已经去掉了。

en: Setup reviews now keep your saved preferences without asking again.
Recurring tasks without a start date now start from today.
zh: 初始化复查会沿用你已经保存的偏好，不再重复询问。
重复待办如果没有开始日期，现在从今天算起。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_en: Morning Sky default and settings icons
notes.title_zh: 默认使用 Morning Sky，设置项有了图标

en: Morning Sky is now the default day theme for accounts without a saved choice; saved choices are unchanged.
Settings titles now show small icons matching the tab switcher style.
zh: 没保存过主题选择的账号，白天默认使用 Morning Sky；已经保存的选择不会变。
设置里的标题现在带小图标，风格和标签切换一致。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 历史记录更清楚，手机上更顺手

en: History conversations stay open with clearer titles and a prominent New conversation button.
Returning from another tab resumes your chat, and older settled chats offer a Resume link.
The message bar stays visible on phones with calmer scrolling.
zh: 历史里的对话会保持展开，标题更清楚，新建对话按钮也更显眼。
从别的标签页回来会接着你的对话，较早结束的对话会提供一个继续的链接。
手机上的输入栏会一直可见，滚动也更平顺。

en: Chats stay private to your tab and login, with a warning before leaving unsent text.
zh: 对话只属于你的标签页和登录账号；有没发出去的文字时，离开前会先提醒你。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: Morning Sky 和 First Light

en: You can now choose Morning Sky or First Light in Settings Appearance, with day and night choices saved separately.
Morning Sky shows clouds with birds, and First Light adds mountains, trees and a valley stream.
zh: 现在可以在设置的外观里选 Morning Sky 或 First Light，白天和夜间的选择分开保存。
Morning Sky 有云和飞鸟，First Light 还多了山、树和山谷里的小溪。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 待办的标题和细节更清楚

en: Tasks now save with clearer titles and helpful details.
Morning Tasks now polish vague wording so cards read clearly.
zh: 待办保存时会带上更清楚的标题和有用的细节。
早间待办会把含糊的说法理顺，卡片读起来更清楚。

en: Automatic titles now look tidier with proper capitalization.
zh: 自动生成的标题大小写更规范，看起来更整洁。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 提醒会说明日程冲突

en: Reminders now name which appointments overlap, ignoring cancelled and all-day events.
zh: 提醒现在会指出是哪几个约定时间撞在一起了，已取消和全天日程不算。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_en: Calmer weather cards and section jumps
notes.title_zh: 天气卡片更安静，章节可以跳转

en: Section buttons now match the Morning and Evening tabs and highlight as you read.
zh: 章节按钮现在和早间、晚间的标签风格一致，阅读时会跟着高亮。

en: Weather now shows clearer temperature, rain chance and air quality.
News now shows short date badges in navigation, headers and previews.
zh: 天气现在更清楚地显示温度、降雨概率和空气质量。
新闻在导航、标题和预览里都会显示简短的日期小标。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 秘书页顶栏更宽，待办更清楚

en: Secretary header now spans the full width like other pages on desktop.
Undated Tasks now appear under To be scheduled instead of No workday assigned.
zh: 电脑上，秘书页的顶栏现在和其他页面一样占满整行宽度。
没有日期的待办现在归到「待安排」下面，不再显示为「未指定工作日」。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 待办更整齐，提醒更安静

en: Tasks now group by day then project with counts, with urgent dues first.
Reminders now show friendly times and clear action labels without extra clutter.
zh: 待办现在先按天、再按项目分组并显示数量，紧急到期的排在最前。
提醒现在用更亲切的时间说法和清楚的操作名称，也没有多余的杂乱信息。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 提问更清楚，保存的改动看得见

en: Questions and permission requests now have clear icons, labels and gentle highlights.
Saved tasks, ideas and calendar changes now appear as tidy status cards.
New items now have a brief entrance animation that respects reduced-motion settings.
zh: 提问和权限请求现在有清楚的图标、标签和柔和的强调。
保存的待办、灵感和日程改动会以整齐的状态卡片显示。
新内容会有一个简短的入场动画，并且会遵循减少动态效果的设置。

en: Typed answers are kept when a permission request arrives, with repeats in separate turns.
Interface labels now update right away when the website language changes.
zh: 权限请求出现时，你已经输入的回答会被保留，重复的请求也会分开显示。
网站语言切换后，界面上的文字会立即更新。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 简报顺序固定，提醒更清楚

en: Needs attention section is now called Reminders, working the same as before.
zh: 「需要注意」这个章节现在改名叫「提醒」，用法和以前一样。

en: Morning briefing now always shows Weather, News, Schedule, Tasks, then Reminders.
zh: 早间简报现在固定按天气、新闻、日程、待办，然后是提醒的顺序显示。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 日程准备说明更简洁

en: Schedule preparation now shows only concise attendee needs, with joining via the original invitation.
zh: 日程准备现在只显示参会者的关键需求，加入会议仍然走原来的邀请。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 中文界面说法更温暖

en: Simplified Chinese wording now reads warm and natural, while limits and safety notices stay exact.
zh: 简体中文的说法现在更温暖自然，限制和安全提示仍然保持准确。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 秘书页面正好放进屏幕

en: Desktop secretary page now fits the screen height with scrolling inside the conversation.
Previous conversations start collapsed on small screens, with your open choice remembered per browser.
Mode-switch labels now stay inside their buttons on narrow screens.
zh: 电脑上的秘书页面现在正好占满屏幕高度，滚动只在对话区域内进行。
小屏幕上，以前的对话默认收起，你展开还是收起的选择会按浏览器记住。
窄屏幕上，模式切换的文字不会再跑出按钮。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 幕后优化

en: Behind-the-scenes improvements; the website works the same.
zh: 幕后优化，网站的使用方式不变。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 过去的空简报更温柔

en: Past dates without a saved briefing now show a kinder empty message.
zh: 过去某天没有保存过简报时，现在会显示一句更温柔的提示。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 页面更稳，报错更清楚

en: Ordinary pages, images and styles now keep loading during login bursts.
Navigation icons, fonts and scrolling now appear correctly throughout the website.
Connection problems now show a readable message without retrying uncertain actions.
zh: 登录高峰期，普通页面、图片和样式也能照常加载。
整个网站的导航图标、字体和滚动现在都显示正常。
连接出问题时会有看得懂的提示，也不会自动重试结果不明的操作。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 日程更丰富，提醒更稳

en: Weekly Schedule now shows saved appointments and untimed tasks with three-week browsing each way.
Reminders now support every-few-days, specific dates and yearly all-day observances.
zh: 每周日程现在会显示已保存的约定和没有具体时间的待办，前后各能浏览三周。
提醒现在支持每隔几天、指定日期，以及每年一次的全天纪念日。

en: Secretary now asks for clarification before saving unclear dates or tasks.
Publishing or regenerating a briefing no longer schedules or completes tasks.
zh: 日期或待办说得不清楚时，秘书会先问明白再保存。
发布或重新生成简报，不再会自动安排或勾掉待办。

en: Early-morning reminders now keep correct timing, with soft targets and workout completions kept separate from hard deadlines and misses.
zh: 清晨的提醒时间现在不会算错了，软性目标和锻炼完成也不会和硬性截止、错过混在一起。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 手机上的形象选择更宽

en: Mobile Morning and Evening avatar picker now shows the selected portrait clearly.
zh: 手机上的早间和晚间形象选择，现在能清楚看到选中的那张。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 繁忙时段也能稳定加载

en: Website now stays connected and keeps login pages loading during busy moments.
zh: 繁忙的时候，网站也能保持连接，登录页面照常加载。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 较长的秘书对话更稳定

en: Long secretary conversations now stay connected and requests no longer get stuck waiting.
zh: 较长的秘书对话能保持连接，请求也不会再卡在等待里。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 秘书的运行指示更灵敏

en: Secretary activity indicator now updates promptly and animates smoothly while respecting reduced-motion settings.
zh: 秘书的运行指示现在更新更及时、动画更顺滑，并且会遵循减少动态效果的设置。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 继续的对话使用最新规则

en: Resumed conversations now use current rules and keep their history when you return.
Requests to follow another mode now work without manual switching.
zh: 继续的对话会按最新规则进行，你回来时以前的记录还在。
要求换成另一种模式时，现在不用手动切换也能生效。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 顶栏去掉分隔线，更干净

en: Header divider line is now removed across Morning, Evening and Secretary tabs.
zh: 早间、晚间和秘书三个标签的顶栏分隔线都去掉了。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 星空夜晚，流程更灵活

en: Starry night theme now adds a calm star field and appears when no color preference is saved.
zh: 星空夜间主题现在会加上一片安静的星野，在没保存过颜色偏好时默认使用。

en: Secretary now follows another mode workflow when explicitly asked without manual switching.
zh: 你明确要求时，秘书会直接按另一种模式的流程走，不用手动切换。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 翻看对话记录更顺畅

en: Inline chat image previews now have square left corners with rounded right corners.
Previous conversations now open without reloading, with back and forward support and correct highlight.
Message drafts now stay separate per conversation and mode, clearing after sending.
History and scroll position now stay put when conversation titles refresh.
zh: 对话里图片预览的左边是直角，右边是圆角。
以前的对话现在打开时不用重新加载，支持前进后退，高亮也正确。
输入框里的草稿会按对话和模式分开保存，发送后就清空。
对话标题刷新时，历史和滚动位置都会留在原地。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 简报保存更安全

en: Briefings now only save from their own page, with fixes through Regenerate.
A clear message now appears when a briefing was changed outside its own page.
zh: 简报现在只能从它自己的页面保存，要修改就用重新生成。
如果在别的页面动过简报，再打开时会看到一条清楚的提示。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 日程和项目步骤更清楚

en: Morning briefings now separate scheduled commitments, project steps, and background reminders more clearly.
Empty project sections are now hidden instead of showing invented tasks.
zh: 早间简报现在把已定的日程、项目步骤和背景提醒分得更清楚。
空的项目章节会直接隐藏，不会再显示编出来的任务。

en: Briefings now show your latest corrected task wording without losing checklist history.
Duplicate task cards no longer appear twice in briefings.
zh: 简报现在会显示你最新改过的待办说法，同时不会丢掉清单的历史。
简报里重复的待办卡片不会再出现两次。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_en: Interrupt the secretary while it works
notes.title_zh: 秘书工作时可以打断它

en: You can now send a follow-up message while the secretary is working to interrupt it.
zh: 秘书还在工作时，你现在可以再发一条消息打断它。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 可以把图片粘贴进对话

en: You can now paste images into chat, preview them before sending, and tap to enlarge them.
Older photo attachments now appear as small inline images.
zh: 现在可以把图片粘贴到对话里，发送前先预览，点一下就能放大。
以前的照片附件现在会以对话里的小图显示。

en: Sent images now look cleaner without extra borders or file details.
zh: 发出去的图片更干净，没有多余的边框和文件信息。

en: Your attached images stay private to your account.
zh: 你附上的图片只属于你的账号，别人看不到。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 手机对话更宽敞，章节跳转更快

en: The message box now grows up to five lines as you type or paste.
A new Sections button on phones lets you jump quickly between page sections.
zh: 输入框现在会随着输入或粘贴，最多长到五行。
手机上新增了章节按钮，可以快速跳到页面的不同章节。

en: Mobile chat now fills the screen instead of leaving a cramped message area.
New conversation now sits below Previous conversations.
zh: 手机上的对话现在占满整屏，输入区域不再挤在角落里。
新建对话现在放在「以前的对话」下面。

en: Connection problems now show a clear message without losing your draft.
zh: 连接出问题时会有清楚的提示，你写的草稿也不会丢。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 自动标题，对话更宽敞

en: The mode guide now explains more about what the secretary can do.
The attach button now sits inside the message box to save space.
Desktop chat now fills the screen with better-aligned avatar and messages.
zh: 模式说明现在讲了更多秘书能做的事。
加附件的按钮现在放进输入框里，省出更多空间。
电脑上的对话现在占满屏幕，形象和消息的对齐也更整齐。

en: Previous conversations now show automatic titles again.
zh: 以前的对话现在又能显示自动生成的标题了。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 秘书页更清楚、更紧凑

en: Previous conversations now show short summary titles instead of clipped messages.
The mode guide now lives behind a question-mark button beside the mode choices.
zh: 以前的对话现在显示简短的摘要标题，不再是截断的消息。
模式说明现在收在模式选项旁边的问号按钮里。

en: The welcome panel now disappears right away when you press Send.
Previous conversations now stays expanded and remembers your open or closed choice.
The avatar upload note is now easier to read over page content.
zh: 你按下发送后，欢迎面板会立刻收起。
「以前的对话」现在会保持展开，并记住你选择展开还是收起。
形象上传的说明在页面内容上更容易看清了。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 对话更好读，简报可以重新生成

en: Secretary replies now show clear headings, lists, links, tables, and code.
You can now regenerate today's briefing after confirmation without losing tasks or feedback.
zh: 秘书的回复现在会清楚显示标题、列表、链接、表格和代码。
确认之后，你现在可以重新生成今天的简报，待办和反馈都不会丢。

en: Project tasks now separate needed work from optional improvements only when work remains.
zh: 项目待办只在还有工作要做时，才把必须做的和可选的改进分开。

en: The message box now glows gently while working, and the send button looks cleaner.
zh: 工作时输入框会柔和地亮一下，发送按钮也更清爽。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_en: Ready to use for new accounts
notes.title_zh: 新账号开箱即用

en: New accounts now start with the default setup ready to use.
zh: 新账号建好后，默认设置就可以直接用。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_en: Clearer message when setup isn't ready
notes.title_zh: 初始化没完成时提示更清楚

en: Accounts that are not set up yet now show a clear page with retry and account options.
zh: 还没完成初始化的账号，现在会看到一个清楚的页面，上面有重试和账号选项。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 控件和弹窗更整齐

en: Patch-note buttons now stay neatly at the bottom right.
The message box now shows a clearer focus highlight without moving content.
The activity window now sits at the bottom left on the Secretary page.
zh: 更新日志的按钮现在稳稳待在右下角。
输入框的聚焦提示更清楚，页面内容也不会跟着移动。
秘书页上的活动窗口现在位于左下角。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 主题、形象，提问响应更快

en: You can now choose Day and Night themes, saved across your devices.
You can now upload a personal avatar that appears in chat and briefings.
zh: 现在可以选择白天和夜间主题，在你各个设备上都会同步保存。
现在可以上传个人形象，它会在对话和简报里出现。

en: Chat has a fresher look with tidier messages, Jump to latest, and a minimizable activity window.
Morning, Evening, and Secretary now share one login on the same site.
zh: 对话换了更清爽的样子：消息更整齐、有跳到最新，活动窗口也能收起。
早间、晚间和秘书现在在同一个网站共用一次登录。

en: Waiting questions no longer block others, answers survive refresh, and expired briefings show a clear message.
zh: 待回答的问题不再挡住其他内容，回答在刷新后还在，过期的简报也会给出清楚提示。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 右上角的菜单更紧凑

en: Language, model, password, and sign-out now live in two compact menus at the top right.
Update status now appears as a small pill at the end of the row.
zh: 语言、模型、密码和退出登录现在收在右上角的两个小菜单里。
更新状态现在变成这一行末尾的小药丸标签。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 对话附件和工作进度提醒

en: You can now attach files in any secretary chat by button or drag-and-drop on desktop.
Attachments show names and sizes up to 50 MB per file and stay when switching modes.
Ongoing secretary or briefing work now shows across Morning, Evening, and Secretary tabs.
zh: 在任何秘书对话里都能加文件，电脑上可以用按钮，也可以直接把文件拖进来。
附件会显示文件名和大小，单个文件最大 50 MB，切换模式后也还在。
正在进行的秘书或简报工作，现在在早间、晚间和秘书标签里都能看到。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 待办更清楚，日程更灵活

en: Completed tasks show a sharp checkmark that is easy to see.
Tasks without times appear at the end of your daily schedule.
Flexible tasks appear once in your checklist, exactly as you wrote them.
zh: 完成的待办会打上一个清楚的勾，一眼就能看见。
没有写时间的待办，会排在当天日程的最后。
时间灵活的待办在清单里只出现一次，内容和你写的一模一样。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 完整的更新日志记录

en: Browse past updates in the patch notes panel in English or Chinese.
Dismissed update notices stay dismissed on all your devices.
Version numbers are simple and easy to follow.
zh: 在更新日志面板里，可以用中文或英文翻看过去的更新。
关掉的更新提示，在你的所有设备上都不会再冒出来。
版本号更简单，也更好认。

en: Missed updates appear automatically without extra clicks.
zh: 错过的更新会自动出现，不用你再多点几下。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 手机上登录表单更稳

en: Sign-in and password forms stay steady and usable on small screens.
zh: 在小屏幕上，登录和密码输入框不会再乱动，能稳稳地填。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 幕后优化

en: Behind-the-scenes improvements; the website works the same.
zh: 幕后优化，网站的使用方式不变。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 幕后优化

en: Behind-the-scenes improvements; the website works the same.
zh: 幕后优化，网站的使用方式不变。

notes.author: GoodMorning agent
notes.title_zh: 给秘书挑个模型

en: Choose Muse Spark 1.3 or DeepSeek V4.1 Flash for your secretary, next to the website language.
New chats use your choice while current work continues undisturbed.
See what is new before and after you update the website.
zh: 在网站语言旁边，就能给你的秘书选 Muse Spark 1.3 或 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash。
新对话会用上你的选择，手上正在做的事不受影响。
更新网站之前和之后，都能看到这次有什么新变化。

en: The refresh button is now called Update.
zh: 刷新按钮现在改叫更新了。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 说清文章预览为什么看不了

en: Briefings explain when an article preview is unavailable.
zh: 文章预览看不了的时候，简报里会说明原因。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 中文排版更舒服，预览更清晰

en: Chinese briefings use clearer and more comfortable text.
zh: 中文简报的文字更清楚，读起来也更舒服。

en: Article preview images look sharper on every screen.
zh: 文章预览的图片在各种屏幕上都更清晰。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 等秘书的时间更短了

en: Waiting requests start sooner once earlier work finishes.
zh: 前面的活儿一结束，排着队的请求就会更早开始。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 按回车就能发消息

en: Press Enter to send a message and Shift plus Enter for a new line.
The message box is ready to type in right away.
Enter never cuts off unfinished character input.
zh: 按回车发送消息，按 Shift 加回车换行。
打开输入框就能直接打字。
正在拼的字符不会因为按回车被截断。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 形象更统一，简报更整齐

en: Choose your secretary avatar from one picker that works everywhere.
zh: 秘书形象只在一个地方选，处处都生效。

en: Briefings look tidier on computers with clear cards and a sidebar.
Morning and evening colors follow your local time.
zh: 在电脑上，简报用清晰的卡片和侧栏排布，看起来更整齐。
早间和晚间的配色跟着你的本地时间走。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_en: Keep the briefing sun and moon
notes.title_zh: 简报的太阳和月亮回来了

en: Morning shows a sun and Evening shows a moon again.
zh: 早间又显示太阳，晚间又显示月亮了。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_en: Shared avatars and clearer chat feedback
notes.title_zh: 形象统一，聊天反馈更清楚

en: Your secretary avatar appears in both chat and briefings.
zh: 秘书的形象在聊天和简报里都会出现。

en: Chats feel quicker with clearer feedback while you wait.
zh: 等待时有更清楚的提示，聊天感觉也更快了。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 用当地文字也能找到城市

en: Weather works when you type city names in their own script.
zh: 用当地文字输入城市名，天气也能查到。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 忙的时候改成排队，不再报错

en: Busy errors are replaced by a fair waiting line.
Waiting requests run in arrival order.
You see your place in line and how many are waiting.
zh: 忙的时候不再报错，改成公平排队。
排队的请求按先来后到的顺序运行。
你能看到自己排在第几位，前面还有多少人在等。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 给秘书起个名字

en: Give your secretary a name during setup.
That name appears in greetings, titles and messages.
A friendly desk illustration welcomes you at setup.
zh: 初始化的时候，可以给秘书起个名字。
这个名字会出现在问候、标题和消息里。
初始化时，会有一张亲切的桌面插画欢迎你。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_en: Safer updates and reliable chat history
notes.title_zh: 更新更安全，聊天记录更可靠

en: Updates never interrupt you or lose unsent messages.
zh: 更新不会打断你，也不会弄丢还没发出去的消息。

en: Chats no longer get stuck showing busy.
zh: 聊天不会再一直卡在忙碌状态了。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 日期更清楚，切换语言即时生效

en: Schedule entries show clear dates that are easy to scan.
Language changes apply instantly, including dates.
zh: 日程里的日期写得更清楚，扫一眼就能看懂。
切换语言马上生效，日期也跟着变。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 网站支持英文和简体中文

en: Switch the whole website between English and Simplified Chinese.
zh: 整个网站都能在英文和简体中文之间切换。

en: New briefings and chats use your current language.
zh: 新的简报和对话会用你当前选的语言。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 网页简报和专属账号

en: Read briefings on their own web pages.
Chat with your secretary on the website.
Briefings appear section by section and stay in an archive.
zh: 简报可以在自己的网页上阅读。
在网站上就能和秘书聊天。
简报会一章一章地出现，并留在存档里。

en: Interrupted briefings recover safely without losing your saved items.
zh: 简报中途断掉也能安全恢复，已保存的内容不会丢。

en: Compact image briefings are removed.
zh: 精简的图片简报已经取消。

en: Your records stay private to your account and stay encrypted.
zh: 你的记录只属于你的账号，并且始终加密。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 简报也会出现在普通聊天里

en: Briefings appear as images in your regular chats.
zh: 简报会以图片的形式出现在你的普通聊天里。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 精简的图片简报

en: Briefings arrive as compact images you can view and share.
zh: 简报会以精简的图片形式送到你手上，可以查看和分享。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_en: Keep idea capture separate from execution
notes.title_zh: 记灵感和动手做，分开放

en: Ideas are saved exactly as you share them, with nothing added unless you ask.
zh: 灵感按你说的原样保存，你不开口，就不会多加半点内容。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 笔记保存可靠，不会重复

en: Your notes and ideas are saved reliably without duplicates.
Your original wording is always kept.
zh: 你的笔记和灵感都能可靠保存，不会出现重复。
你原本的说法始终会被保留下来。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 待办按你写的原样保存

en: To-dos are saved exactly as you write them, with no extra questions.
Deadlines and completion stay in your control.
zh: 待办按你写的原样保存，不会再追问别的。
截止时间和是否完成，都由你说了算。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 对话标题跟着语言走

en: Chat titles match your secretary reply language.
zh: 对话标题会和秘书回复所用的语言一致。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 导入的日程先等你晚上过一遍

en: Imported calendar events wait for your evening review before applying.
zh: 导入的日程会先等你晚上过一遍，你确认后才生效。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 幕后优化

en: Behind-the-scenes improvements; the website works the same.
zh: 幕后优化，网站的使用方式不变。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_en: Save ideas before asking for clarification
notes.title_zh: 先存下灵感，再问你问题

en: Your ideas are saved before any clarifying questions.
Open questions stay visible for later follow-up.
Suggestions stay separate from approved plans until you confirm.
zh: 有需要问清楚的地方之前，先把你说的灵感存下来。
还没弄清的问题会留在那里，之后还能接着跟进。
在你确认之前，建议和已经定下的计划分开放着。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 早间和晚间的标题统一了

en: Morning and evening briefings use clear dated titles that are easy to find.
zh: 早间和晚间简报的标题都带上日期，清楚又好找。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: Betterbird 里的重复日程

en: Repeating calendar events import correctly, including exceptions.
zh: 重复的日程能正确导入，例外的那几次也算在内。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 秘书最早的一批工作

en: Morning and evening briefings, secretary chat and idea capture begin.
Briefings include weather, air quality, news and calendar help.
zh: 早间简报、晚间简报、和秘书聊天、随手记灵感，都从这里开始。
简报里有天气、空气质量、新闻和日程方面的帮助。

en: Project access requires your permission.
zh: 访问项目需要先得到你的许可。

notes.author: Git history
notes.title_zh: 一切从这里开始

en: GoodMorning gets its first home; the secretary and website come later.
zh: GoodMorning 有了第一个家，秘书和网站是后来的事。
